summary: A Cash App user reported that their account was abruptly closed which prevented withdrawing approximately 4000 USD worth of BTC to a cold wallet. The user stated they were forced to sell the BTC for USD to regain access creating an unwanted taxable event.
user_mistake: Stored bitcoin on a custodial payment platform without self custody control
prevention: Withdraw bitcoin to a self custody hardware wallet after purchase / Avoid holding significant balances on custodial payment apps
